statement: The survivor is Alex Morgan, Survivor profession, Evacuee scenario, in the world Jauca
The game starts inside evac shelter C-41; its wooden door on the south wall leads out to a forest
The NPC Vito Hostetler in the shelter is asthmatic and asked the player to fetch an inhaler within a couple of days; the player agreed
Vito Hostetler gave equipment after a persuasion check: protein rations, bottles of clean water, an emergency jacket and an emergency blanket
The survivor carries 6 sealed plastic bottles with 2 clean water each and 8 protein rations
The standalone flashlight has dead batteries; the smartphone's flashlight app works as a light source
A wooden club can be crafted from one plank with a cutting tool (the pocket knife) using fabrication skill; a plank comes from smashing a shelter bench
Smashing a bench in the shelter leaves nuts and bolts, scrap metal and splintered wood on the floor
The survivor wields a crafted wooden club, wears the emergency jacket and carries the emergency blanket
The evac shelter lies in forest west of the town Whitingham
Plan: develop sustainable food and water, avoid unnecessary combat, no save of Alex yet, no debug or cheats

note: Crafted and wielded a wooden club from a bench plank
Left the shelter into the forest; the inhaler errand was relevant to where to go
